production.note: US model years 2021-2024. First: the 2021 release introduces the "first-ever four-cylinder" GR Supra 2.0, "anticipated to start arriving at Toyota dealers in June". Still offered for 2023 ("a new Stratosphere Blue color, which will also be available on Supra 2.0", toyota-2023-supra-manual) and 2024 ("or the GR Supra 2.0 grade with an inline 4-cylinder engine that outputs 255-hp", toyota-2024-supra). Last: Toyota's 2025 page says "The 2025 GR Supra is available in two grades: 3.0 and 3.0 Premium" (toyota-2025-supra); MotorWeek (Alex Kellum, 28 June 2024): "That means the '2.0' grade, and thus the four-cylinder engine itself, has been cut from the lineup." (motorweek-2025-supra).

body.note: Inferred: same two-door fixed-roof body as the GR Supra 3.0; the cited page does not use the word coupe.

displacementL.note: 1,998 cc per Toyota (GB)'s GR Supra technical specifications ('Displacement 1,998', 'In-line 4-cylinder with single twin-scroll turbo'); a UK-market sheet, used for the displacement only. US releases say '2.0-liter'.

aspiration.note: One twin-scroll turbocharger: '2.0L inline four-cylinder with twin-scroll single turbo'.

fuel.note: Inferred from the petrol four-cylinder described on the cited page; the page does not name the fuel.

transmission.note: "The Supra 2.0 uses the same 8-speed automatic transmission as the 3.0". The six-speed manual added for 2023 was offered only on the 3.0 grades ("The manual transmission will be available as an option on the Supra 3.0 and 3.0 Premium", toyota-2023-supra-manual).

powerHp.note: Quote: "The bottom line is 255 hp at 5,000-6,500 rpm and a stout 295 lb.-ft. peak torque at 1,550 to 4,400 rpm." Unchanged through 2024 ("outputs 255-hp and 295 lb.-ft. of torque", toyota-2024-supra).

weightLb.note: 2021 model, 8-speed automatic (the only transmission). Quote: "At 3,181 pounds, it is more than 200 pounds lighter than the Supra 3.0 while maintaining that model's exemplary near 50:50 weight distribution." Toyota's sentence does not say 'curb weight'; Toyota Canada's copy of the release gives the same in its table: 'Weight ... 3,181 lbs.' (toyota-canada-2021-supra-release).
